purpose: Provenance for repository-backed figures displayed in the portfolio

GHOST-X.boundary: Hardware behavior, deterministic analytic software truth and runtime characterization are separate evidence classes; no metrology, universal-superiority or hard-real-time claim.
GHOST-X.presentation: Regenerated from the pinned repository data with ghost_sim_ros2/tools/generate_public_results.py; presentation-only changes add title spacing, plot headroom and remove an overlapping annotation. Values, inputs and evidence boundaries are unchanged.

ASTRA-OS.boundary: Software assurance and Raspberry Pi execution evidence; the browser console is a behavior model, not the native executable or a real-time qualification.
ASTRA-OS.presentation: Mode and fault timelines were regenerated from pinned command telemetry with the upstream generator after a presentation-only left-margin and label-spacing adjustment; telemetry values are unchanged.

AeroFrame-DT.boundary: Educational, synthetic, non-OEM and non-certified. Correlation figures use a 7075-T651 specimen and are not the released 7050-T7451 fitting result.

Fixed-Wing Flight Controls SIL.boundary: Representative, low-order, F-16-inspired software-in-the-loop model; not validated aerodynamic performance or flight readiness.

files.f16/longitudinal-response.png: Rendered from committed run_autopilot default configuration by the portfolio audit
